alt: Real ChatGPT /recall execution: fast prompt entry, sending, accelerated generation and normal-speed widget use.
caption: New temporary chat → PDF → shortcut → generation → extended widget use
prompt: /recall Using only the attached chapter, build an interactive active-recall widget on training versus inference. Include three questions with reveal/hide answers. Answer in English.
setupPrompt: Use the attached chapter as the only source for the next activity. Please wait for my next request.

phases.name: upload
phases.caption: Open a new temporary chat and upload the chapter PDF.

phases.name: setup-generation
phases.caption: ChatGPT reads the uploaded chapter · accelerated.

phases.name: typing
phases.caption: Write the shortcut request as the second message.

phases.name: send
phases.caption: Send the shortcut as the second message.

phases.name: widget
phases.caption: Inspect the generated widget before using its controls.

phases.name: usage
phases.caption: Use the widget at normal speed.

actions.label: Recall the training/inference distinction, then reveal the expected answer.
Hide the first explanation and attempt the distinction again from memory.
Reveal the prompt-context explanation for the second question.
Open the third explanation and compare the proposed experiment.
Reveal the remaining answer to complete the three-question review.
Inspect the counter showing all three explanations revealed.
Reset all three answers for a fresh recall attempt.
Reveal the training distinction again after the reset.
Hide the answer to leave the question ready for another independent attempt.

deliveryNormalization.method: Aspect-preserving Lanczos downsample from 1664x1040 to 1440x900. H.264 CRF14; original 60 fps cadence and duration preserved. Native media retained in the ignored pre-pull review archive.
